title: BotHub builder node definition
description: One file per node type in shared/nodes/. Read by the dashboard (editor), the API (validation) and the bot (interpreter). Modules and plugins ship their own definitions in the same format.

version.description: Increase when inputs, outputs or config change incompatibly.

labelKey.description: i18n key for the node title.

infoKey.description: i18n key of an info box shown at the top of the block settings.

module.description: Owning module. The node is only available when the module is enabled in the guild.

requires.description: Plugin permissions needed to use this node (plugin nodes only).

config.description: JSON Schema for the node config. Editor extensions per property: x-labelKey (required), x-hintKey, x-enumKey (i18n prefix for enum values), x-multiline, x-mono, x-placeholder, x-showIf ({field: [values]}), x-kinds (state nodes: condition kinds that use the field), x-widget (custom editor: permissions, form), x-advanced (shown under Advanced), x-ref (member, channel, category, role, roles, message: value is a block variable or channel/message ID), x-group (rendered by a widget), x-undoTitleKey/x-undoHintKey (undo widget), x-permissionGroups (permissions widget: palette groups).

group.description: Palette section inside the category tab, i18n key builder.group.<group>.

order.description: Sort position in the palette; groups follow their first node.

color.description: Node color; default is the category color.

icon.description: Short icon for the node (letter or emoji).

locked.description: Fixed node (trigger, error handler): cannot be removed or added from the palette.

palette.description: false: not offered in the palette (e.g. condition states).

conditionKind.description: Condition nodes: how their states are written (compare, chance, match, option = select menu branches).

wide.description: Wide node box (message blocks with buttons and menus).

produces.description: What the block creates that later blocks can point at (message: its variable holds the sent message).

results.description: Values a block leaves for later blocks: {<variable><suffix>}. Shown as copy chips.

portType.description: `flow` carries execution order. All other types carry data. `list<T>` is a list of T. `any` accepts every data type.

required.description: Inputs only: a data input that must be connected or have a config fallback.

multiple.description: Inputs: accept several edges. Outputs of type `flow` always allow several edges.
